label: Shuffle
depicts: Two separated path arrows bending around each other in opposite lanes without crossing into an X
use_when: Use when the interface wants shuffle to read as two separate arrow lanes rather than one crossed X shape.
avoid_when: Do not use for the crossed shuffle when both path arrows should intersect at the center before exiting rightward.

label: Signature
depicts: Handwritten signature line making one tall zigzag stroke and one short tail at the lower right
use_when: Use when the interface wants a freehand signature drawn as one loose handwritten stroke with no extra frame.
avoid_when: Do not use for the signature mark with the diagonal line and curved ring stroke around it.

label: Signature
depicts: Diagonal signature line crossing through one curved ring stroke with a short tail below
use_when: Use when the interface wants the signature to feel more structured with a diagonal line and curved ring around it.
avoid_when: Do not use for the looser signature squiggle when the mark should not include the wrapped ring stroke.

label: Snowstorm
depicts: Two horizontal wind bars pushing toward two small snowflake stars on the right side
use_when: Use when the interface wants snowstorm to read like blowing wind carrying snow across the screen.
avoid_when: Do not use for the cloud snowstorm when the weather cue should start from a cloud outline with snow falling below it.

label: Snowstorm
depicts: Cloud outline with four small snowflake stars hanging below the lower edge
use_when: Use when the interface wants snowstorm to read as a cloud releasing snow instead of wind bars pushing flakes sideways.
avoid_when: Do not use for the blowing snow variant when the weather cue should not start from a cloud outline.
